bayts.text: I have loved the Lord of the worlds, together with the Trustworthy (Gabriel) and the Trustworthy (Muḥammad),
and His faithful remembrance has yielded to my breast and my body.
I have conversed intimately with the Lord of the mighty Throne, with love, together with well-strung pearls;
and He has been for me with (a gift) immense, and has guarded me from my enviers.
My Lord, the Refuge, has directed my heart to the Oneness of the One,
and has not entrusted me to anyone, in my journey and in my land.
Toward me He has led, in the journey, my intimate friend and my beloved (Muḥammad), with triumph,
making me free of need of people, by His hosts, within my soul.
No challenger has come against me, and the outpouring of my Lord is manifest:
Iblīs does not challenge the host of the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), the One.
None who opposed has come against me, nor he in whose heart is a sickness,
and for me my Lord leads, in the aim, what is not denied.
Allah has been for me with what keeps (water) clear and cool
tomorrow; and for me (He gave) sustenance with what He led, and the best of ease.
The gift of Allah, the Helper, has driven the accursed (Satan) toward others than me,
and today, through me, Allah helps whom He wills, and (so) tomorrow.
Allah has extended to me the glad tidings, by the standing of the master of mankind,
and for me He has spread His blessing; I have not turned toward what does not profit.
Allah, the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), has taught me of what He wills among the sciences,
and has repelled my adversary with wounds, so that he went away in chains.
I have conversed intimately with my Lord, the Generous, with writings that do not cease,
their lights; and for me Aḥmad desires the best of gifts.
Allah, Lord of the worlds, has blessed the Guide, the Trustworthy (Muḥammad),
in the (celestial) Assembly of the perfected, on behalf of our spirit and body.
